summary.short: Peru's implementing regulation of Law 29733 on personal data protection. Sets consent, transparency, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, children's data, security, incident notification, data protection officer and registration duties for public and private controllers and processors, with sanctions. Applies 120 days after publication.
summary.long: Approves the Regulation of Law 29733 (Peru's personal data protection law) and repeals Supreme Decree 003-2013-JUS. It has 135 articles, six final and two transitional provisions, and applies 120 calendar days after publication in El Peruano. It sets rules for consent (free, prior, express, informed; written for sensitive data), information duties and revocation, plus special rules for children and adolescents. Cross-border transfers require an adequate level of protection or contractual guarantees and a notice to the authority. Processors and subcontractors have specific duties. Controllers must notify security incidents within 48 hours and keep security documents and access controls. A data protection officer is required for public entities and for large-volume or sensitive-data processing, with staggered deadlines by company sales. Data subjects have access, rectification, cancellation, opposition and portability rights, and a right not to be subject to solely automated decisions. The Dirección General de Transparencia supervises and sanctions; infractions are minor, serious or very serious, with coercive fines and corrective measures.

obligations.conditional_on: Where the objection is justified

evidence.quote: debe proceder al cese del tratamiento que ha dado lugar a la oposición

obligations.summary: When personal data are processed as part of a decision-making process without the participation of the data subject, the controller must inform the data subject as soon as possible.
obligations.conditional_on: Automated or other decisions made without the data subject's participation

evidence.quote: debe informárselo a la brevedad posible

obligations.summary: Direct requests to the controller must be answered within the periods set by the Regulation, stating the response to each element of the request.

evidence.quote: debe dar respuesta, en los plazos previstos en el presente Reglamento

obligations.summary: A request for a tutela procedure must meet listed requirements, including a copy of the prior request to the controller and the controller's response, and documents evidencing the harm where applicable.

evidence.quote: la solicitud del titular de los datos personales debe cumplir con los siguientes requisitos

evidence.quote: se corre traslado al reclamado y se otorga un plazo de quince (15) días

obligations.summary: The tutela procedure must be resolved within 30 days, extendable by up to 30 additional days depending on the complexity of the case.

evidence.quote: El plazo máximo en que debe resolverse el procedimiento trilateral de tutela es de treinta (30) días

obligations.summary: The Directorate grants the appeal and forwards the file within 2 days; the Directorate General serves the appeal and decides it within 30 days.
obligations.conditional_on: Upon an appeal against a tutela resolution

obligations.summary: The Directorate of Personal Data Protection must require from the holder, processor or responsible party information about the processing or the necessary documentation; supervision is initiated ex officio or upon a complaint.

obligations.summary: The supervision authority must notify the supervised party of the date and time of an on-site inspection, except where prior notice is not given.

evidence.quote: en un plazo razonable, comunica al

obligations.summary: Each on-site inspection visit must be recorded in a minutes document, signed by the inspectors and the supervised party or staff who participated, with a copy given to the supervised party.

evidence.quote: requieren el levantamiento del acta correspondiente, en la que se deja constancia

obligations.summary: Inspection staff must display a valid credential bearing a photograph and carry a signed written order identifying the place, the purpose and the legal basis of the visit.

obligations.summary: Inspection minutes must record the listed items, including the inspected party, the date and place, the type of action, the order number and date, and the information request and deadline.

evidence.quote: se debe hacer constar

obligations.summary: The supervision activity concludes with a report, which must be prepared within 90 days from the start of the activity, extendable once by up to 45 days by reasoned decision.

evidence.quote: debe ser elaborado en un plazo máximo de noventa (90) días

obligations.summary: The sanctioning procedure is initiated by notification of the charges, made by the Directorate of Supervision and Investigation.

evidence.quote: que contiene lo siguiente

evidence.quote: emite el Informe Final de Instrucción, en un plazo máximo de cincuenta (50) días

obligations.summary: The resolution of the sanctioning procedure must be reasoned, address the defences and the charged facts, and be notified to the parties and to the complainant where applicable.

obligations.summary: The reconsideration appeal is decided by the Directorate within 15 days; appeals are resolved by the Directorate General within 30 days of receipt of the file.

evidence.quote: surte efecto a partir de los 6 meses posteriores a la entrada en vigencia del presente Reglamento

enforcement.authority: Dirección de Protección de Datos Personales (first instance); Dirección General de Transparencia, Acceso a la Información Pública y Protección de Datos Personales (second and last instance)
enforcement.triggered_by: Infractions of the Law or the Regulation, classified as leves (Art. 132), graves (Art. 133) and muy graves (Art. 134)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Multa de acuerdo con el artículo 39 de la Ley N.º 29733; no amount is stated in this text
enforcement.penalty_formula: Fine amount is determined under the Metodología para el cálculo de multas (Art. 123.2); the administrado may prove prior-year gross annual income, per the second paragraph of Art. 39 of the Law (Art. 124.1); for several independent infractions the fines are summed up to twice the fine for the most serious (Art. 117.2); the fine for the most serious infraction applies where one conduct qualifies as several (Art. 117.1); reincidence is an aggravating factor (Art. 135.3); prompt payment before appeal gives a reduction of 40% (Art. 127.2)
enforcement.penalty_reference: Art. 39 of Law 29733 (cited in Art. 131); Metodología para el cálculo de multas, Resolución Ministerial N.º 0326-2020-JUS (Art. 123.2)
enforcement.cure_period: No cure period stated; remedial measures adopted after notice of charges are a mitigating factor (Art. 125.2)

evidence.quote: se sancionan con multa de acuerdo con el artículo 39 de la citada Ley

enforcement.authority: Dirección de Protección de Datos Personales
enforcement.triggered_by: Non-compliance with corrective measures or precautionary measures (Art. 130.1)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Coercive fines: leves up to 2 UIT; graves 2 to 6 UIT; muy graves 6 to 10 UIT; repeated non-compliance doubles the last fine up to 100 UIT
enforcement.penalty_formula: Tier set by the class of infraction (Art. 130.1); if non-compliance persists, a new fine doubling the last fine, up to 100 UIT (Art. 130.2); imposed automatically without prior request (Art. 130.1); no appeal against the imposition (Art. 130.4)
enforcement.cure_period: Fine to be paid within five (5) days, after which coercive collection is ordered (Art. 130.3)

evidence.quote: hasta el límite de cien (100) Unidades Impositivas Tributarias (UIT)
